name: retire-review-pr-surface
title: Retire sd-review-pr: port the fleet integration-only review profile into sd-review
description: Delete the sd-review-pr command surface after porting the fleet integration-only review profile into sd-review. Split from 07-24-remove-retired-review-surfaces: sd-review-pr solely implements a trusted nested contract that sd-fleet-refresh depends on, so its removal is a behavioral migration, not a deletion. Also owns full-check.sh + review-full-check.sh deletion, the run_pack_source_drift_gates relocation, the make check recomposition, the FULL_CHECK/REVIEW_PR env families, and the plugin closure allowlist.
